title: Officer home, case queue and taxpayer profile on the new shell
scope: Rebuild Overview as a workspace home of action items (overdue, awaiting evidence, awaiting approval, failed processing) and the case queue and taxpayer profile as toolbar-plus-table pages with saved views and counts in the sidebar, display options, export of the visible columns and pagination

acceptance.text: The queue has one toolbar row (search, filters, display options, export, one primary action), a usage line, sortable dense table with column help, muted empty values and a row 'Open' action; filters and sort survive reload through the URL
Sidebar views (My cases, Awaiting evidence, Awaiting approval, Overdue) show counts from the same API used by the table; numbers are never invented
Overview and taxpayer profile fit the page-length budget; existing queue e2e tests still pass

Screenshots at 1440, 1024 and 390px with loading, empty, error and denied states, keyboard/focus and axe results, and the TAX-144 page-length result; record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Updated unit and Playwright tests on the fixture build

evidence.text: CaseQueueView on the TAX-145 kit: one TableToolbar row at 1440 (search, status and refund-lane filters, Display options kept in localStorage, Export CSV of exactly the visible columns, one primary action 'Open first case'), UsageLine ('Showing 7 of 7 cases · 1 overdue · 2 awaiting approval'), DataTable (dense, sortable with aria-sort, column info on Why selected/Status/Evidence due, muted dash for empty values, 'Open' row action). View, search, filters, sort and page are in the URL and survive reload (queue.spec.ts).

Sidebar views My cases, Awaiting evidence, Awaiting approval and Overdue count the same case list the table shows (shared useCaseList over GET /api/v1/cases). Awaiting approval and Overdue use the new optional server-computed Case.attention (contract + fixture server from review state, seeded evidence requests); without it the count is undefined and the view says it is unavailable (domain/queue.test.ts, tests/contracts/test_case_attention.py). queue.spec.ts checks every view's count equals its rows.

Overview (action items Overdue, Awaiting approval, Awaiting evidence, Processing failed with counts, first cases and links to the views; cases by status) and taxpayer profile (key facts, open-cases toolbar and table) are 1.00 viewports at 1440x900, as is the queue. Existing queue e2e tests pass (auditor e2e 66 passed; smoke.spec updated for the 'My cases' view name and the failed-processing action item).

docs/evidence/TAX-147: 32 screenshots at 1440/1024/390 (each view, display options, overview, taxpayer, loading/empty/error/denied); queue.spec.ts 17 passed with axe, keyboard focus on the Open action, product names and the page-length budget; npm run check and dev.py check pass; full frontend suite 323 passed, 9 failed (demo-recording harness only).
